points.description: Gives the core perceptron learning procedure: start with weights (randomly or otherwise initialised), then loop over the labelled training examples and update the weights using the learning rate eta and the input x when the example is misclassified (the model answer's condition <w,x> <= 0), repeating over epochs until the weights stop changing much.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the student describes the weight update on misclassified points or repetition over epochs but leaves out one of these elements (e.g. the initialisation or the stopping condition).

rubric.notes: Full marks for a student who describes the perceptron learning loop in any wording: initialise weights, for each example that is misclassified update w by adding eta times x (using the labels), and repeat over epochs until the weights settle. Give 1 mark for a vague or partly complete loop, such as an update rule with no repetition or repetition with no update rule. Give 0 for an empty, off-topic or wrong answer such as a description of a different model; pseudo-code syntax and exact formatting do not matter, and the convergence remark is not required.
